notices.rj-mitte-life-tribute: If you're struggling or thinking about suicide, you are not alone and help is available. In the US, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline); in Canada, call or text 988 (Suicide Crisis Helpline), any time. In the UK and Ireland, Samaritans: 116 123. Anywhere else, find a free, confidential helpline at findahelpline.com. If someone is in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
